title: knowledge(upgrade): clarify DataTransfer defaults and bypass safety
summary: The BCQuality upgrade articles on DataTransfer were corrected: DataTransfer is preferred for equivalent field initialization and copies at any record count, with no 300,000-record threshold. A field being new no longer counts as a reason to skip validation, triggers or subscribers.
key_points: Explains that 300,000 is a SaaS upgrade cap, not a minimum for using DataTransfer
A new field alone does not make bypassing validation, triggers or subscribers safe
Anti-pattern limited to tables that can realistically grow large; valid ModifyAll calls and needed loops are kept
Base App samples replaced with self-contained bad and good examples
Microsoft Learn CopyFields measurement cited as an example, not a guarantee
